symbolCleanup.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / precise identity-preserving cleanup.
The attached image is the EDIT TARGET. Extract and carefully clean ONLY the BOTTOM RIGHT symbol labeled 5B: the upright right-facing black bear with ONE broad sinuous white opening rising from its lower edge. The user has explicitly selected this exact design. Deliver that ONE symbol by itself on a genuinely transparent background; the internal white opening must also be transparent.

Preserve its recognizable silhouette, proportions, pose, single small round ear at upper left, gently humped head, slightly lifted blunt snout facing right, concave throat on the right, broad rounded haunch at lower right, short left foreleg and characteristic broad winding negative-space opening. Preserve the inviting upturned posture. Preserve the exact concept and asymmetry of 5B; DO NOT use the mountain-containing 5A from above.

Make only controlled craft refinements: smooth tiny contour wobbles and kinks, make curve joins fluid, keep the base visually stable, and make the opening clear at small size. Aim for one precise, economical vector-like silhouette, not a redrawn mascot with a new personality. Strictly solid black fill and alpha; no interior facial features, eyes, nose dots, mouth, fur, outlines, extra limbs, mountains, stars, badges, circular surrounds, added motifs, or logo text.

Composition: one large complete emblem centered in a square canvas, around 78% of canvas width with generous even breathing room. Crisp clean edge quality, appropriate for tracing into an actual vector master. No shadows, texture, gray shading, gradients, visible paper, letters, numbers, labels, mockups or borders. Show ONLY the selected 5B bear, with its characteristic winding negative space, as a transparent reusable standalone asset.

lettering.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset: ONE black-and-white typographic pairing study for an ALREADY SELECTED symbol. This is a controlled lettering study, not a new symbol search.

Input image 1 is the cleaned selected 5B bear asset, with transparent background. It is the identity reference: KEEP THIS SYMBOL'S ACTUAL OUTLINE, PROPORTIONS, upturned right-facing head and SINGLE broad winding negative-space opening. Input image 2 is supporting provenance: the approved original is bottom-right 5B only, not the mountain bear above. All three rows must use the SAME selected 5B bear, not redraw it into three variants. Do not add eyes, nose dots, facial details, paws, mountains, extra marks or badges.

Composition: landscape WHITE canvas with THREE spacious horizontal rows. In each row, the same solid black bear at the left, and a carefully drawn black wordmark to its right. The bear is modestly taller than the wordmark and should feel optically balanced with it, not huge like a mascot illustration. All rows have identical emblem scale and alignment. Only small neutral labels "01", "02", "03" at the far left of the corresponding row. No headings, explanatory captions or other text.

Three genuinely different and carefully art-directed wordmark structures:
01 — exact text "tastiq", all lowercase. A custom soft humanist grotesk with open counters, confidently full strokes, modest width, single-storey a, short expressive t, and a compact q descender. Warm, direct, ownable. Refined optically spaced lettering with one subtle distinctive curve echoing the bear's inner opening; not puffy bubble letters, not a ready-made geometric startup typeface.
02 — exact text "TASTIQ", all uppercase. A sturdy, compact, rounded-corner display grotesk: more taut and self-assured than row01, carefully balanced wide T and A, lively S, compact final IQ, a clean quiet Q tail. Optical spacing rather than widely tracked branding. Strong and crisp without cyberpunk, gaming aggression, stencil cuts or ornamental letter mutilation.
03 — exact text "Tastiq", uppercase T and the rest lowercase. A confident low-contrast SOFT SLAB SERIF with short rounded/bracketed serifs, generous counters and warm editorial character. Substantial enough to balance the bear, distinctive letter shapes, not thin luxury fashion typography, not western/outdoor badge lettering, not a script.

The user's earlier complaint was generic AI-looking font swaps. These three should look like deliberate lettering treatments whose mass, rhythm and proportions relate to the SAME selected mark. The symbol is already the memorable element; the lettering should form a coherent logo with it. Legibility is essential: preserve exact spelling T-A-S-T-I-Q, proper q not g, no extra letters.

Pure black shapes on pure white. Clean flat vector-like artwork. No colors, gradients, paper texture, drop shadows, mockups, device frames, cards, underlines, taglines, slogans, stars, watermarks, or decorative divider artwork. No redesign of the selected bear. Deliver the three complete horizontal logo pairings, with plenty of breathing room, at large readable size.
